offers_products.reason: WorkWise workforce management software and vendor management technology are named among its main offerings, alongside staffing.

offers_services.reason: Healthcare staffing (travel nurses, locums, allied, per diem, permanent), consulting and language interpreter services are core.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are healthcare organizations; clinicians are placed as workers, not as consumers of the service.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Hospitals, health systems and other healthcare organizations buy staffing, locums and workforce technology.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat staffing assignments and multi-year managed service programs with health systems generate ongoing billing.

cyclical_demand.reason: Healthcare staffing for hospitals is driven by clinician shortages and patient care needs, though clients can cut travel staffing.

big_ticket.reason: Staffing assignments and per-hour billing are routine and repeated, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for placed nurses, physicians and allied clinicians; without staff the service stops.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are hospitals and health systems, with CHRO, CNO and CFO solutions, plus government facilities.

asset_heavy.reason: Staffing business placing clinicians; needs recruiters and software, not plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Cyclicality is mixed: travel nurse demand fell sharply after the pandemic peak, though healthcare demand is generally steady.
